verdict.rationale: Twenty offers an official app-building toolchain: the `create-twenty-app` scaffolder and `twenty` CLI let developers define objects, fields and views as code, live-sync with `dev`, and publish apps with custom UI, server logic and AI skills or agents. It also documents REST, GraphQL and Metadata APIs with per-workspace generated docs. However, no evidence names an official client SDK library for any language, so integration otherwise relies on raw API calls, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404s. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented official SDK package (e.g. typed TS/Python client libraries), SDK reference docs, a published OpenAPI spec for codegen, and independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK/app framework.
